name: Claude's structured outputs instead of parsing its text
gain: Anthropic's words: outputs follow your schema, so "no more JSON.parse() errors" (vendor claim). No measured number here.
how: Send the schema in output_config.format, or pass a Pydantic model or zodOutputFormat() to client.messages.parse(). Keep the old parser as a fallback and add a test that the same keys come back.
replaces: JSON.parse or json.loads on Claude text, fence stripping, retry-on-parse loops.
trade_offs: The first request with a new schema is slower while its grammar compiles; grammars are cached for 24 hours from last use.
Refusals and max_tokens can still return output that does not match the schema, so those two stop reasons need handling.
Only a subset of JSON Schema is supported, and assistant prefill is incompatible.
needs: A supported model; claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 and newer are on the page, and retired models are not.
usage_signal: Retries and output tokens on calls that are re-sent after a parse failure

gain_model.formula: parse_failure_rate * calls * cost_per_call = money lost to retries

inputs.name: parse_failure_rate
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: calls
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

test_recipe.what_to_compare: parse failures and schema errors, before and after

verify_rule: Parse-error logs and retried calls over 14 days after merge

change_recipe.how: Send the schema in output_config.format, or pass a Pydantic model or zodOutputFormat() to client.messages.parse(). Keep the old parser as a fallback and add a test that the same keys come back.
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
